mapping.draft_py:
# {1}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
# Silversmote Ghoul's move of itself from your graveyard (the source over Zone(GRAVEYARD, YOU)), so the
# ability works only from the graveyard (CR 113.6m, legality.activation_zone).
reassemble = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(CostManaColor(color='B', amount=QConst(value=1)), CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)))),
    effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
        'cards': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE, filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),)),
        'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        'tapped_on_enter': True,
    }),
)
abilities = [reassemble, *compiled]

clauses.clause: {1}{B}: Return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

mapping.notes: M8 mapper. Silversmote Ghoul's move of the source from your graveyard, so it works only there (legality.activation_zone). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/reassembling_skeleton_*.json.
